The '''SBSS reduced length barrel''' was a model of [[shortened barrel]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Produced by [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]], the attachment was sold for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].
